items.spokenPrompt: Listen. Which word fills the gap?
items.storyText: The sun is up! Hi! This is my uncle. He is a vet. Do you have a cat? No, I don't. What is that? It is a small tiger!
items.why: In “Story 7”, you hear: The sun is up! The missing word is “sun”.
